diagrams.title: Reviewed npm release flow
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  merge["Reviewed develop commit"] --> resolve["Resolve immutable SHA"]
  resolve --> trust["Develop ancestry and package identity"]
  trust --> validate["Read-only validation job hashes tarball"]
  validate --> publish["Separate OIDC-enabled publish job"]
  publish --> metadata["gitHead integrity and dist-tag verification"]
  metadata --> release["GitHub Release"]

diagrams.title: Release state transitions
diagrams.mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Planned
  Planned --> Validated: build test audit pack
  Validated --> Published: absent version
  Validated --> Reconciled: matching version and bytes
  Published --> Reconciled: registry integrity converged
  Reconciled --> Released: GitHub Release verified
  Planned --> Failed: trust or validation failure
  Validated --> Failed: digest or registry mismatch

diagrams.title: Credential and artifact trust boundaries
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  untrusted["PR and package scripts"] --> readonly["Validation job: contents read only"]
  readonly --> artifact["SHA-256 and SHA-512 bound artifact"]
  artifact --> privileged["Publish job: OIDC and NPM_TOKEN"]
  privileged --> registry["npm registry dist.integrity"]
  attacker["Wrong ref or altered artifact"] --> reject["Fail before registry or tag mutation"]

clauses.statement: An npm version is successful only when its registry gitHead equals the requested full release commit SHA.
clauses.rationale: npm versions are immutable and a same-version different-commit collision must fail loud.

story_refs.text_snippet: 異なるcommitに結び付いた同一versionを成功扱いしない

clauses.statement: Only npm 404 means a package version is absent; authentication and registry failures remain failures.
clauses.rationale: Treating an unavailable registry as absence can cause an unsafe duplicate publish attempt.

clauses.statement: The workflow validates and publishes an immutable merged or manually selected commit, not a moving branch checkout.
clauses.rationale: Build, test, publication, and npm gitHead evidence must refer to one commit.

test_refs.case: binds validation and publish to the merged commit

clauses.statement: The npm credential is injected only from GitHub Secret NPM_TOKEN at publication time and is never committed.
clauses.rationale: Package publication credentials must remain outside source and workflow logs.

story_refs.text_snippet: 公開jobだけへGitHub SecretとOIDCを許可

test_refs.case: binds validation and publish to the merged commit

clauses.statement: Plan, validation, publication, and verification are authorized only for @unson/brainbase-mcp.
clauses.rationale: A reviewed package rename must not redirect the publication credential to another npm package.

story_refs.text_snippet: 公開jobだけへGitHub SecretとOIDCを許可

clauses.statement: A release commit must be reachable from the trusted default branch and the publication checkout must be clean.
clauses.rationale: The packed artifact must be attributable to the reviewed commit recorded as npm gitHead.

clauses.statement: Build, test, audit, and real tarball creation run in a read-only job without OIDC or an npm credential; publication requires matching SHA-256 and SHA-512 proof and registry dist.integrity.
clauses.rationale: Untrusted validation children must not inherit any public package mutation capability, and publication must prove the registry received the reviewed bytes.

story_refs.text_snippet: 検証jobと実行tarball proofはnpm公開トークンなしで再現

clauses.statement: Verification reads npm metadata and dist-tags but never publishes or changes a dist-tag.
clauses.rationale: Audits must be safe to repeat without public registry mutation.

clauses.statement: An absent version is first published under a commit-bound non-consumer staging tag; the consumer tag changes only after version, gitHead, and integrity converge, and the staging tag is then removed.
clauses.rationale: Unverified or partially converged package bytes must never become the default consumer selection.

test_refs.case: publishes an absent version once and retries metadata to convergence
does not reconcile a dist-tag when registry metadata never converges

clauses.statement: Consumer dist-tags move only forward; publication is restricted to the package-wide upstream Actions queue, and a current-tag SemVer guard prevents an older release from rolling a tag back.
clauses.rationale: A local queue bypass or stale versions snapshot must not overwrite a newer consumer selection.

test_refs.case: does not roll back a dist-tag advanced by a concurrent release
rejects direct local publication outside the package workflow queue
serializes every publication attempt for the package

clauses.statement: The packed manifest repository identifies the public Unson-LLC/brainbase source repository used for npm provenance.
clauses.rationale: npm provenance must bind the package to the reviewed public source repository rather than an internal or missing repository identity.

test_refs.case: binds validation and publish to the merged commit
audits production dependencies and hashes a real tarball without publication credentials

clauses.statement: A manual workflow dispatch can publish or reconcile the package version at a selected release ref.
clauses.rationale: The first 0.1.0 publication has no preceding version bump and failed runs need an idempotent recovery path.
